The contract files did not change during frontend repairs, so the recorded contract run applies throughout. Web tests, TypeScript and build were rerun after the final CSS repair.

Native T3 browser checks used the local production build at port 3113. Geometry was checked at 320, 390, 768, 1440 and 1920 CSS pixels; detail controls also at 901, 1024 and 1120. No document overflow was found. Mobile artwork/metadata separation was checked at 320, 390, 420, 560 and 720, with at least 19px clearance.

Browser behavior checked:

- All/open/ended filters, empty-filter reset, zero/single/multiple catalog fixtures.
- Expired and exhausted fixtures display accurate unavailable status and disable the demo action.
- All four direct detail routes and artwork mappings, reloads, back navigation and missing-piece handling.
- Gold quantity 2 calculates 510 USDC including a 10 USDC fee and 80 bonus entries. Quantity 6 disables recording.
- Attempting the demo action without agreements shows the required-agreements error and creates no entry. No agreements were accepted and no wallet transaction was attempted.
- Skip-link keyboard navigation reaches main content. Footer destinations resolve, and native Privacy navigation works. Footer remains transparent and links fit/wrap on mobile.
- Fixed headline geometry across six animation times at every acceptance width. Native animation clocks/end states and scroll-reveal completion were observed after browser rendering recovered.
- Live motion-preference JavaScript handler was exercised through a browser matchMedia event harness. CSS reduced-motion handling was source-reviewed. Physical OS preference switching and real-device GPU/FPS profiling were not performed.

The native snapshot tool initially failed and browser animation clocks stalled. Geometry checks at that stage explicitly finished finite animations programmatically. Snapshot capture later recovered; actual desktop landing/cards/detail, tablet landing, mobile landing/detail/eligibility/footer screenshots were inspected. Final screenshot copies are `artifacts/refresh/home-desktop.png` and `artifacts/refresh/home-mobile.png`. Browser recording still failed and is not claimed as evidence. Raw geometry evidence is in `artifacts/refresh/browser-evidence-initial.json` and `artifacts/refresh/browser-evidence-final.json`.

Independent review and browser QA found and repaired headline layout shifts, sticky-header anchor occlusion and mobile artwork overlapping disclosure text. Final review accepted the repaired candidate. Local synthetic fixtures were restored after checks.
